card.name: Small linking words mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as and, may, with, being, not and broad, placed just before the next descriptive term in a list or clause. The pole responds in both label text and general web prose.

modes.label: and in lists
modes.description: The word and joins the last items in a list of symptoms, adjectives or nouns.
modes.example: vomiting, diarrhea<< and>> failure to gain weight

modes.label: Helper words before a predicate
modes.description: Words like may, with, not or being come right before the verb phrase or noun that completes the clause.
modes.example: Systemic effects of topical corticosteroids<< may>> also include Cushing's syndrome

card.writes: It promotes digit tokens like 2, 1 and 3 and suppresses odd rare characters, so it slightly favors a number coming next.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words like and, may or with, right where the sentence is about to continue.
